question: Does a common absorber remain electrically reachable from each servo after source isolation or branch opening?
method: Directed connectivity of candidate topology; no transistor or motor model
stop_condition: Enumerate five declared states once; record missing paths and revise topology requirements, without parameter sweeps
assumptions: An intact ordinary conductor or fuse conducts both ways
Source disconnect is open in both directions when commanded off
A servo can remain a regeneration source after supply removal
Absorber node means a proposed energy sink, not a rated implemented part
limitations: Connectivity is necessary, not sufficient: voltage, energy, current, delay, temperature and independence are not verified
Servo cable detachment is a separate operating/fault condition needing an explicit design decision
